jobs.title: Project Manager/Senior Project Manager, Preconstruction
jobs.description:
The Company

The energy industry is entering one of the most significant periods of growth and transformation in its history. Meeting the nation’s growing demand for reliable electricity will require new ideas, new infrastructure, and talented people committed to building for the future.
At Cypress Creek Energy, we’re meeting that challenge by developing and operating the energy infrastructure needed to power communities, support economic opportunity, and strengthen resilience. We believe our responsibility extends beyond the grid and that how we build matters just as much as what we build.

That same commitment extends to our employees. We invest in professional growth, encourage collaboration across teams, and provide opportunities to take ownership, expand your expertise, and advance your career. Our culture is grounded in safety, accountability, respect, and a shared commitment to deliver results. Join us and help meet one of the most important energy challenges of our time while building a rewarding career.

Overview

Cypress Creek Energy (CCE) is seeking a Project Manager/Senior Project Manager of Pre-Construction
reporting to the Senior Director of Pre-Construction
.
This person will work collaboratively with Development and Execution to support construction due diligence, including constructability reviews, risk analyses, developing project schedules, reviewing budgets & capex estimates, and analyses of EPC RFP's. Also responsible for reviewing and addressing the up-front construction and execution-related issues early in the project life cycle to ensure all stakeholders are aligned so that projects are executed on time and within budget. Oversees managing the RFI and RFP processes for all assigned projects to move them from the development phase to the execution phase. Formally turns over the executed contract to the Director of Project Execution.

Responsibilities

Works closely with Development to help review and address upfront construction and execution-related issues earlier in the project lifecycle, including constructability assessments, site visits, permitting, collaboration with JHA’s, and general collaboration and support of the early to mid-stage projects
Leads development of detailed baseline Project schedules which incorporate the appropriate durations necessary for each of the respective teams to perform and complete their work including contingencies
Provides input and review of pipeline project schedules for investment approval projects
Support the completion of preliminary engineering specifications for construction and supply contracts
Contribute to the development of detailed project management and construction strategy including implementation plans, budgets, and schedules
Manage the EPC RFP process including the scoping, identification, evaluation, selection, and final approval
Lead EPC contract execution including early-stage engineering and design in conjunction with legal, contract management, and execution
Participate in the identification and selection of suppliers
Coordinate with Cost Estimating & Controls to develop and maintain project budgeting and cash spend forecasts
Manage the integration and alignment of all project stakeholders – host weekly project status meetings
Develop effective relationships with contractors and suppliers to support the execution strategy
Embrace and live by the mission and values of Cypress Creek Renewables
Additional duties as required

Education & Experience Required

Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management; or equivalent years of experience in construction, project planning and execution of large utility-scale, power plant projects
3-8 years in the renewable energy sector or industrial construction or capital project management
Advanced knowledge of construction management and constructing methods for large projects, contract management, procurement, and supply chain management, environmental and building permitting, and transportation logistics
Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining critical path method schedules
Extensive experience with EPC and BOP construction contracting; including RFP process, bid review, and negotiation of contract terms; renewable energy contracting experience is highly preferred
Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office software, including MS Project
Basic knowledge of construction labor relations throughout the US
Works well under pressure and on a deadline, enjoys working with a variety of people

Location:
This position is fully remote in Houston, Texas, with an expected 30%-50%+ travel time to projects located across the US.

Benefits

15 days of Paid Time Off, accrual up to 20 days, 11 observed holidays.
401(k) Match
Comprehensive package including medical, dental, vision and health insurance
Wellness stipend, family planning stipend, and generous parental leave
Tuition Reimbursement
Phone Bill Reimbursement
Company Swag

A note to Recruiting Agencies Cypress Creek Energy Human Resources team does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. The Human Resources team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. We do not accept resumes from third-party recruiters unless authorized by the Human Resources team and if a signed agreement is in place. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered property of CCR and we are not responsible for any related fees. All communication related to recruiting partnerships should ONLY be directed to the Human Resources team.

Cypress Creek Energy is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace that is inclusive and values diversity, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please be aware of recruiting scams—official communications will only come from @ccrenew.com, we will never request personal or financial information, and any suspicious activity should be reported to HR@ccrenew.com.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Role Description

Technical Project Manager

The Role

UST is seeking a highly technical and hands-on Technical Project Manager to lead a team in managing end-to-end networking upgrades for one of the leading healthcare providers in the US. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in project management, excellent communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

Project Leadership and Execution:
Lead and manage the networking upgrade team, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
Develop detailed project plans for networking upgrades, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation, and ensure successful execution.
Utilize your technical background to understand project requirements and provide technical guidance to the team.
Work as a hands-on technologist when needed, applying technical skills and experience in the development and delivery of upgrade solutions following established methodologies, processes, and practices.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

What You Need

Technical Skills & Knowledge:
Strong background and deep understanding of the healthcare industry.
Strong background in data management and data warehousing projects, with familiarity with data warehousing and ETL tools, preferably Ab Initio.
Strong background in AWS infrastructure and related migration projects.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Microsoft Project).
Working knowledge of UNIX systems and databases (e.g., DB2, Postgres).
Expertise in planning and managing networking upgrades, including data encryption and hardware upgrades.
Ability to assess the impact of upgrades and develop mitigation strategies.
Experience in developing and delivering training programs related to networking upgrades.
Knowledge of business intelligence and analytics tools such as Cognos or Tableau.
Awareness of security standards in data handling.
Experience:
Minimum 10 years of IT industry experience, including application system design and implementation.
Experience in managing ETL and data warehousing projects.
Experience in the healthcare industry, including knowledge of medical and prescription claims processing, healthcare enrollments, and provider operations.
Experience in managing projects with multiple release streams, including soliciting business priorities, organizing scope into releases, building roadmaps, managing scope changes, and communicating with leadership and technical teams.
Experience in managing projects that handle PHI (Protected Health Information) and PII (Personally Identifiable Information) and sensitive data.
Experience managing technical estimates, including estimation planning and managing the technical team to deliver estimates.
Experience in building a culture of continuous improvement, identifying opportunities for project/program technical delivery improvements, including process improvements, quality management improvements, knowledge sharing/management improvements, collaboration tool improvements, and program reporting tool improvements.
Educational Qualifications:
Required: bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.
Preferred: master's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.
PMP certification in mandatory

Location & Compensation

Compensation can differ depending on factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, education, and level of experience. UST provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in various U.S. markets as set forth below.

Role Location: Remote - US

Compensation Range: $88,000-$132,000

Who We Are

Since 1999, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a powerful impact through transformation. Headquartered in the United States, UST is powered by technology, driven by AI, inspired by people, and led by our purpose, we partner with our clients from design to operation. Our AI-driven digital solutions, proprietary platforms, engineering, R&D, products, and innovation ecosystem turn core challenges into impactful, disruptive business outcomes. With deep industry knowledge and a future-ready mindset, we infuse expertise, innovation, and agility into our clients’ organizations—delivering measurable value and positive lasting change for them, their customers, and communities around the world. Together, with 30,000+ employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at .

Benefits

Full-time, regular employees accrue a minimum of 10 days of paid vacation per year, receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year), 10 paid holidays, and are eligible for paid bereavement leave and jury duty. They are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as the following Company-paid Employee Only benefits: basic life insurance, accidental death and disability insurance, and short- and long-term disability benefits. Regular employees may purchase additional voluntary short-term disability benefits, and participate in a Health Savings Account (HSA) as well as a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for healthcare, dependent child care, and/or commuting expenses as allowable under IRS guidelines. Full-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year) and are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) program with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Part-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year).

All US employees who work in a state or locality with more generous paid sick leave benefits than specified here will receive the benefit of those sick leave laws.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.

jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

MAKE A DIFFERENCE AT OCHIN

OCHIN is a nonprofit leader in health care innovation and a trusted partner to a growing national provider network, delivering the clinical insights and tailored technologies needed to expand patient access, strengthen care teams, and improve the health of rural and medically underserved communities.

We are hiring for a number of new positions to meet increasing demand. When you choose to join OCHIN, you have the opportunity to continuously grow your skills and do meaningful work to help fulfill our vision of good health and well-being for everyone.

At OCHIN, we value the unique perspectives and experiences of every individual and work hard to maintain a culture rooted in our values.

Founded in Oregon in 2000, OCHIN employs a growing virtual workforce of more than 1,200 skilled professionals, working remotely across 49 states. We offer a generous compensation package and are committed to supporting our employees’ entire well-being by fostering a healthy work-life balance and opportunity for professional advancement. We are curious, collaborative learners who strive to live our values every day. OCHIN is excited to support our continued national expansion and the increasing demand for our innovative tools and services by welcoming new talent to our growing team.

Position Overview

The Project Manager
supports OCHIN’s mission by driving the successful scoping and execution of projects, such as Epic implementations and enhancements, third-party vendor implementations, and internal initiatives, to ensure successful execution and resource management across cross-functional teams. This role involves creating and executing project plans, consulting senior leadership, fostering collaboration across the organization, gathering and analyzing data for potential integrations, and supporting the efficient delivery of integrated products and services. Additionally, the role balances competing priorities, navigates technical and business constraints, and partners with internal and external stakeholders to solve complex challenges.

Essential Functions

Lead cross-functional projects from initiation through completion, aligning timelines, priorities, and outcomes to organizational goals.
Manage resources and workload effectively by balancing competing priorities and ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones.
Facilitate clear and impactful communication by tailoring messages to diverse audiences, facilitating alignment, providing project updates, and guiding stakeholders through project risks and decisions.
Collaborate across members, teams and vendors to resolve challenges proactively, foster mutual accountability, and ensure successful project outcomes.
Analyze and identify opportunities for improvement by optimizing processes, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement across teams, projects, and solutions.
Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

2+ years of experience in project coordination or management, business analysis, or technical solution roles preferred
Experience leading or supporting cross-functional projects, preferably in healthcare, IT, or a related field preferred
Familiarity with Epic or other EHR systems, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar tools is a plus
PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification preferred
Epic certification or healthcare-related credentials (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) are a plus but not required

Physical Requirements/Work Environment

Constant interpersonal skills, teamwork, and customer service. Frequent creativity, mentoring, presentations/teaching. Occasional decision making and independent judgment or action.
Reading, speaking, writing, and understanding English.
While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit for long periods of time; stand and walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; reach with hands and arms.
This position requires a virtual home-office environment, working remotely.
The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers and mobile devices.
Travel is required to support OCHIN’s business requirements for go-live installations or training which may require travel by air, vehicle, or train.

Work Location and Travel Requirements

OCHIN is a 100% remote organization with no physical corporate office location. Employees work remotely from home and many of our positions also support our member organizations on-site for new software installations. Nationwide travel is determined based on OCHIN business needs. Please inquire during the interview process about travel requirements for this position.

Work From Home Requirements Are

Ability to work independently and efficiently from a home office environment
High Speed Internet Service
It is a requirement that employees work in a distraction free workplace
Travel required up to 20% nationally for on-site Go Live support based on business requirements for OCHIN
(OR) Travel may be required nationally based on business requirements for OCHIN

We offer a comprehensive range of benefits. See our website for details: https://ochin.org/careerCOVID-19 Vaccination Requirement

To keep our colleagues, members, and communities safe, OCHIN requires all employees—including remote employees, contractors, interns, and new hires—to be vaccinated with a COVID-19 vaccine, as supported by state and federal public health officials, as a condition of employment. All new hires are required to provide proof of full vaccination or receive approval for a medical or religious exemption before their hire date.

Equal Opportunity Statement

OCHIN is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills for the benefit of our staff, our mission, and the communities we serve.

As an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer, OCHIN, Inc. does not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, marital or civil union status, age, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristics. At Cypress Creek Energy, we’re meeting that challenge by developing and operating the energy infrastructure needed to power communities, support economic opportunity, and strengthen resilience. That same commitment extends to our employees. jobs.title: Fire Sprinkler Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join Us

Drive Fire Protection Excellence as Fire Sprinkler Project Manager
– Lead, Influence, and Deliver

Are you a proven project leader who thrives on managing high-profile fire protection projects from concept through completion? Do you enjoy building trusted client relationships, driving operational excellence, and delivering solutions that protect people, facilities, and mission-critical infrastructure?

CHA Consulting, Inc. is seeking a Fire Sprinkler
Project Manager
to join our Fire Protection Services Team
in Birmingham, AL; Cullman, AL; or remotely
. In this pivotal role, you will lead complex fire protection projects, oversee project performance, and serve as a trusted advisor to clients while helping shape the successful delivery of innovative fire and life safety solutions. This position is remote-flexible, with a strong preference for candidates located throughout the Southeastern U.S. to support our growing regional presence. The role includes occasional travel to project sites and client meetings as needed.

What You'll Do

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex fire protection projects, ensuring projects are completed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with client expectations
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships and navigating technical, financial, and logistical challenges throughout the project lifecycle
Direct project scope development, schedules, budgets, change orders, and resource planning while maintaining project quality and profitability
Manage project financial performance, including forecasting, budgeting, cash flow, revenue tracking, and Estimates at Completion (EACs)
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors, and technical leaders to drive project success and achieve key milestones
Oversee contract administration, project documentation, client communications, and project reporting from kickoff through closeout
Develop and implement project-specific health, safety, and quality initiatives while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements
Provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to junior project management staff and technical team members as projects grow in scale and complexity

What You Bring

High school diploma required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Minimum of 9 years of fire sprinkler experience required, including at least 6 years of project management experience
Strong knowledge of fire protection systems, fire alarm installations, life safety requirements, and construction project delivery
Proficiency with design software (AutoCAD, HydraCAD, Revit, etc.) required
Demonstrated success managing client relationships, project financials, schedules, contracts, and project risks
Experience preparing change orders, project plans, work authorizations, and project closeout documentation
Strong understanding of NFPA code requirements, OSHA standards, and fire/life safety regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence project outcomes across diverse stakeholder groups
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and management software required; knowledge of Deltek Vision preferred
NICET certification preferred; project management certification is a plus
Valid driver’s license required with the ability to travel as needed

jobs.description:
Sektor finansowy w ponad 30-letniej historii firmy Comarch ma na swoim koncie tysiące zrealizowanych projektów na całym świecie! Nasza oferta sprawia, że wyróżniamy się wśród najbardziej prężnych dostawców systemów informatycznych i oprogramowania finansowego. Wysoka jakość, doskonała wydajność oraz duża elastyczność naszych rozwiązań pozwalają przedsiębiorstwom na efektywne zarządzanie swoimi finansami. Znajomość metodyk prowadzenia projektów informatycznych oraz narzędzi wspomagających zarządzanie projektami, np.: Jira, MS Project
Pierwsze doświadczenia w zarządzaniu ludźmi lub silne predyspozycje liderskie (rola przewiduje rozwój w kierunku kierownika subcentrum)

Zdolność pracy w zespole, oraz budowania i utrzymywania dobrych relacji ze wszystkimi interesariuszami projektu
Sprawność w podejmowaniu decyzji, rozwiązywania trudności projektowych oraz nastawienie na znajdowanie nowych rozwiązań
Umiejętność analitycznego myślenia oraz wyciągania wniosków
Samodzielność, komunikatywność, inicjatywa oraz orientacja na realizację celów
Dodatkowym atutem będą szkolenia i/lub certyfikaty z metodologii zarządzania projektami np. certyfikat PMP

Budowanie i utrzymywanie trwałych relacji z klientem oraz rozumienie jego potrzeb biznesowych
Zarządzanie projektami wdrożeniowymi systemów informatycznych dla klientów polskich i zagranicznych
Organizacja i koordynacja pracy zespołów projektowych

Współpraca z doświadczonymi specjalistami realizującymi projekt
Raportowanie wewnętrzne i do klienta

Możliwość korzystania z zaawansowanych narzędzi AI i Google Workspace

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager, Panes Center of Excellence – VELUX - Brædstrup

Step into a role where you will contribute to the development of robust and efficient manufacturing solutions. With your technical insight and hands-on understanding of production environments, you will play a key role in developing and improving production setups that support innovation, cost efficiency, and successful New Product Launches.

Meet your future team

You will join Center of Excellence (CoE) Panes in Brædstrup, where we work at the intersection of operations and development. CoE Panes is a global team located in Brædstrup. We are a team of project managers and technical specialists focusing on the future manufacturing setup in VELUX.

We have a holistic view on the entire supply chain to make sure the manufacturing processes involving Panes are as efficiency as possible, safe for our people and according to our process standard and quality requirement.

In this role, you will primarily collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders based in Denmark, while also supporting selected assembly sites in Europe when relevant.

What We Offer

In this role, you will manage a wide range of technical projects across glass manufacturing. You will transform new product concepts into mature production setups, implement technological upgrades, and help transfer and scale solutions across factories. You will act as the connector between product development, technology, and production, ensuring that new technologies and products are introduced efficiently and with high production robustness.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

Leading projects from concept to implementation, within the field of glass manufacturing.
Defining technical specifications and managing the procurement of manufacturing technologies and production equipment (cutting, tempering, laminating, and production lines).
Participating in process optimization, quality improvement, and product cost reduction initiatives across all glass manufacturing plants of the VELUX Group.
Preparing and maintaining technical requirement specifications in close cooperation with the relevant stakeholders.
Project planning, coordination, and execution, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and within budget – in close collaboration with the glass factories.
Problem-solving and close cooperation with cross-functional teams.
Supporting the standardization of production lines and technical solutions across the various sites

International travel of approximately 40–50 days per year, primarily within Europe, should be expected.

What You Will Bring

You are a structured, proactive, and collaborative Project Manager who takes ownership and delivers consistently. You thrive in a highly technical environment and enjoy working across factory sites, functions, and cultures. Your curious mindset and analytical approach enable you to challenge existing processes and contribute to continuous improvements, always with the goal of creating business value.

Through strong communication and stakeholder management skills, you build trust and ensure alignment across teams. When priorities shift, you remain adaptable, focused, and solution oriented.

Moreover, we expect that you:

A higher education degree in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, mechanical engineering, automation, or a similar field
At least 4-5 years of experience in preparing technical specifications and procuring production equipment.
Experience in technical project management and project planning/execution.
A thorough understanding of manufacturing and assembly processes and their interconnections.
Practical knowledge of manufacturing technologies is an advantage, ideally with experience in glass technology, though not a requirement.
Well-developed problem-solving skills.
Understanding of laser technology, ventilation solutions, and manufacturing processes in clean room environments is highly desirable.
Bring several years of practical project management experience in a technical environment with multiple workstreams
Have strong planning and coordination skills and are comfortable delegating and following up
Communicate effortlessly in English, verbally and in writing. Danish is an advantage but not required

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all requirements. We value different career paths, learning ability, and motivation.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at https://www.velux.com, where you can read more about working with us and what to expect from our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work, and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots. Each year, we create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees, and the planet through our foundations. With production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people worldwide, and our headquarters are in Denmark.

Our values of courage and mutual respect guide how we act and collaborate every day.

At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive, develop, and perform at their best. jobs.description:
Join us in driving the energy transition forward. As Project Delivery Manager, you'll coordinate the delivery of our biomethane projects in Poland, connecting development and construction to keep projects moving with clarity and purpose.

What you will do:

Coordinate and deliver assigned biomethane projects from development through Ready-to-Build and construction support until Commercial Operation Date
Lead the structured handover from Development to Construction, ensuring technical, commercial, permitting and contractual information is fully transferred
Act as primary point of contact after handover, supporting the Construction team and ensuring continuity of decisions and information
Maintain project documentation, trackers and transparent reporting on progress, risks, budget and schedule
Coordinate activities required to reach Ready-to-Build, including permitting, land and grid-related workstreams
Monitor schedule and budget against the approved business case, flagging deviations early and escalating when needed

At Lam Research, the Program/Project Manager is part of the Global Operations Group. This group brings together information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing to drive the engine of Lam’s Global business operations. They help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam’s business.

The impact you’ll make

As a Program/Project Manager, you will serve as a crucial link between the manufacturing and supply chain departments. Your role involves consistent interaction with both sectors to minimize shipment risks. This is achieved by ensuring the accuracy of components, their location, quantity, and quality. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain experience in Supply Chain Management while maintaining a close understanding of manufacturing operations. Your contributions will be pivotal in enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of our operations.

What You’ll Do

The candidates most successful in this role are individual contributors, self-starters, that can thrive both independently day-to-day and as a part of collaborative teams as they are a vital part of expediting material to meet manufacturing and customer delivery dates.
Analyzing Data: This position requires analyzing data in SAP and internal shortage tools to identify, validate, mitigate, and roll up material risk.
Supporting Manufacturing and Delivery: Support expediting key material to meet manufacturing and customer delivery dates. The person will act as an interface to cross-functional teams consisting of manufacturing, order fulfillment, logistics, and engineering to ensure the manufacturing production and customer delivery are met.
Risk Management: The pivotal function of this job is alarming material risks in advance and escalating on time to prevent shipment risk.
Collaboration: Requires collaboration with Global Operations team and consisting of Buyers, Commodity, Supplier Business Managers, Manufacturing, Engineering, and leadership to find all possible solutions to mitigate material allocation priority. Develop and deliver clear and concise communications for leadership teams and stakeholders.
Scenario Planning: Be capable of scenario planning based on provided forecasted plan to share supplier healthiness and drive root cause action plan for improving internal process to prevent shipment delay.
Project Management: Manage non-technical, supply chain projects using an internal customer perspective, typically from initiation through delivery. Build solutions that will improve Supply Chain business processes and support critical business strategies.
Forecasting and Planning: Provide forecasting, planning and strategic execution support to the supply chain to meet current and future business requirements.
Develop and monitor risk mitigation strategies and coordinate root cause corrective actions.
Lead and participate in projects to resolve problems or to support continuous process improvement.
Develop timely reports and key performance indicators to identify/monitor material delivery challenges.

We are seeking an experienced IT Project Manager to join our Software Development team. In this role, you will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of custom software projects that support our clinical and business operations. Conduct post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and improve future project delivery.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience);
3+ years of experience managing IT or software development projects;
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies, including Agile;
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders;
Proficiency with change management tools (e.g., Microsoft Azure DevOps);
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects; and
Demonstrated experience managing project timelines and cross-functional teams.

PMP, CSM, or other relevant project management certification;
Experience working in a Contract Research Organization, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other regulated life sciences environment;
Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, or SOx;
Experience managing custom software development projects (rather than only vendor/COTS implementations); and
Working knowledge of software development concepts sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams.

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. 1168169_RR00126350 Job ID: 1168169_RR00126350

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.

For more information, go to med.nyu.edu , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , X and Instagram .

Position Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Senior Program Manager, Research.

We have an exciting opening for a Senior Program Manager within the Ronald O. Perelman Department of Emergency Medicine, Research Division. In this role, the successful candidate will work under the direction of Principal Investigator and Medical Director for Geriatric Emergency Medicine, Dr. Ula Hwang.

The Senior Program Manager will be responsible for providing a broad range of program management across a minimum of three large scale projects and/or programs. Responsible for the development, promotion, and direction of assigned programs, including program design, budget, staffing, logistics, deliverables, operations, and other supportive functions. Provides direct supervision for coordination of program activities. Develops and implements new research strategies for specific projects. Facilitates the administration of departmental activities (recruiting and on boarding process, drafting IRB protocols, managing IRB submissions and modifications; data use and subaward Agreements, developing annual program budget, scheduling meetings, planning, organizing and coordinating seminars, training and other related activities).

Reports directly to Principal Investigator but works autonomously and with limited oversight.

Job Responsibilities

Demonstrates knowledge of the organization's Core Values and incorporates them into the performance of duties.

Supervision - Supervision of research and program staff, including scheduling, evaluation, ensuring roles and responsibilities are being carried out, and providing support for professional development activities.

Project/Program Management - Uses judgment to provide coordination for program activities to Principal Investigator in the planning, preparation, organization, analyses, coordination and delivering of projects and programs while working with internal and external parties to organize the various components needed to initiate, run and conclude major programs. Coordinates/Communicates program activities with concerned parties including vendors and users. Coordinates special technical trainings related to program (e.g., statistical software). Organizes and leads regular project meetings to ensure completion of project activities in adherence with timeline. Coordinates project activities across multiple projects.

Program/Operations Support: Recruits, hires, trains, and supervises program and research coordination staff, trainees and volunteers and ensures all office policies and procedures are being implemented. In the future, may require nationwide recruitment for study participants, phone screening, data collection, and records keeping.

Research Activities: Gathers, collects data from different parties, ensures accuracy, analyzes findings, and presents recommendations as applicable. Responds to requests for information, summaries, and data based on information compiled from various sources. Plans, develop materials and presentations for training and educational sessions, departmental seminars, and other activities. May oversee staff in these activities. Manages oversight of data use agreements, subawards, and services agreements.

Budget: Participates in the development and administration of program budgets. Responsible for the budget management and resources allocation and assist the department with following up accounts payable/receivable accounts. Reviews workflow and recommend improvement if applicable to ensure appropriate cycle times and efficiency.

Grants and IRB: Prepares grant applications, reports as to status of grants and proposal submission as required by the department if applicable, including researching for donators and funding sources, contacting connections, searching grants requirements, deadlines and drafting the proposal. Might develop business plans to identify areas of research and grant opportunities. Identifies new funding

opportunities and sources for research grants. Prepares grants proposal (coordinates reviews and compiles contracts and reviews and edits contents); Initiates and manages grants. Identifies items affecting the establishment or awarding of grants. Follows up and coordinates resolution of all issues and resolves processing problems. Updates, coordinates, and monitors staff CITI trainings

Reports: Prepares and issues reports within established procedures such as Interim, Annual and Final Research Performance Progress Reports. Analyses findings/data and presents recommendations. Prepares and review documents independently and generates status/progress reports for ongoing and pending program related projects. Plans, arranges, outlines, and drafts letters, memos, agendas presentations and reports. May oversee staff assigned to this responsibility.

Presentations: Prepares outlines, drafts and finalizes presentations supporting meetings, program organization, conference presentations. Leads and presents presentations.

Abstracts/Manuscripts: Prepares and drafts medical and scientific abstracts, manuscripts, and proposals reflecting team interests and goals, as well as preparing documents that support programs and projects engaged and supported by team for dissemination purposes.

Participates in special projects and performs other duties as required.

Performs other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications

To qualify you must have a Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in healthcare administration or related discipline. Minimum of seven years progressively responsible related research experience with at least three years serving in a managerial capacity over research projects. Proficiency in using various Microsoft Office applications such as World, Excel, Access, Powerpoint and Outlook. Familiar with Internet applications. Effective verbal and written communication skills, and strong analytical, organizational and interpersonal skills. Ability to interface effectively with all levels of management and work and communicate effectively with both internal and external customers. Ability to work within a team environment as well as independently. Commitment to continuous learning as required by department administration. Ability to make decisions independently. Ability to manage time, multitask and prioritize work. Strong understanding and knowledge base of coordination requirements associated with clinical/research trials. Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems; ability to work well under pressure

Preferred Qualifications

Master's or PhD degree in business administration, health care administration, or related field. Experience coordinating research studies, institutional review board protocols, data use agreements, and engaging in direct supervision. Knowledge of statistical software such as R or SQL is preferred. Successful candidates are able to function independently, are inquisitive, anticipatory, resourceful, and enjoy critical thinking.

Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.

This position will work a hybrid schedule which includes a combination of working both onsite on Campus (3 days) and remote (2 days).

Description

The Department of Pediatrics is one of the largest departments within the School of Medicine with approximately 171 Faculty, 50 postdoctoral fellows (both MDs and PhDs) along with over 300 support staff (not including hospital staff). In addition, the Department has 57 clinical residents and fellows distributed across the Divisions. The missions of research, education and patient care are intertwined, and are integral to the goals of the department.

The Department has undergone significant growth in recent years with a consolidated budget of approximately $106 million including sponsored projects expenditures of approximately $54 million and clinical revenue of over $ 52 million. This expansion of the Department’s research and clinical portfolio is expected to continue in the next few years.

The Department’s 16 divisions include Academic General Pediatrics, Child Development & Community Health; Allergy, Immunology and Rheumatology; Cardiology; Environmental Science and Health; Emergency Medicine; Endocrinology; Gastroenterology; Genetics; Genome Information Sciences; Hospital Medicine; Host-Microbe Systems and Therapeutics; Infectious Diseases; Neonatology; Nephrology; and Respiratory Medicine.

In 2001, physicians and leadership of the University of California, San Diego (UCSD), Rady Children's, and Children's Specialists of San Diego (CSSD) unified pediatric patient care, research, education and community service programs, creating a university-affiliated children's health system to serve the region. Over the past two decades, an extensive list of joint programs has developed, with many physicians and researchers playing a role at both institutions.

This affiliation has consolidated the clinical, teaching, research and public service programs of the UCSD School of Medicine's Department of Pediatrics with San Diego's only health care system dedicated to the health and well-being of children. In 2009, this partnership was furthered by the creation of Rady Children’s Specialists of San Diego, a Medical Foundation, and is now recognized as having global leaders in research, technology, translational medicine, education and clinical excellence.

The Division of Environmental Science & Health is involved in four major areas: 1) providing clinical services to patients with birth defects and developmental disabilities, 2) providing public health services in counseling patients, providers and education to the public about pregnancy and lactation exposures and their impact on child development and health, 3) a teaching program that includes undergraduate students, graduate students in epidemiology, medical students, and post -doctoral students, pediatrics, epidemiology, health behavior, global health, pharmacy, and other specialties; and 4) conducting clinical research to better understand the causes, prevention and treatment of birth defects and developmental disabilities. Research programs and projects within the Division involve federal, state and industry sponsored grants and contracts totaling over $60 million. These encompass national and international studies that require complex interrelated infrastructure and shared resources both within the Division and with collaborators and subcontractors outside the Division.

Under the general supervision of the Research Manager, the incumbent directly supervises and manages a team of Research Data Specialists for the OTIS MotherToBaby Pregnancy Studies. The OTIS Research Center is located within the Department of Pediatrics, Center for Better Beginnings at UCSD. The OTIS Research Center conducts multiple federal and industry sponsored longitudinal observational cohort studies focused on pregnancy outcomes in women exposed and unexposed to specific chronic diseases, medications and/or vaccines. The studies recruit and follow several thousand study participants across the US and Canada.

The incumbent is responsible for hiring, training, evaluating, and supervising a staff of Research Data Specialists who review and abstract medical records, clean study data as needed, validate maternal interviews, and perform other medical record review and data collection tasks. The incumbent is responsible for managing medical record abstraction and validation of abstraction and maternal interview collection, assigning and directing the work to the study team; monitoring progress, goals, and objectives of the team; ensuring compliance with standard operating procedures, data entry and record-keeping protocols, and quality control of abstraction and data cleaning tasks. The incumbent prepares or oversees generation of various team reports, and creates and updates study manuals or oversees updates to these guides. Create long-term workload projections, participate in identification, testing, and implementation of new technologies to create efficiencies. The incumbent may participant in other study activities, or oversee staff participating in other study activities, such as socio-economic scoring (SES), validation of maternal interview data collection and data-entry, or other activities as needed or as requested by the Research Manager. Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Nine (9) years of related experience, education/training, OR a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus five (5) years of related experience/training.
Broad knowledge of clinical or laboratory research and clinical research philosophy. Demonstrated ability to translate clinical research philosophy into business best practices in a trial setting.
Demonstrated project management skills. Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities, prioritize projects and meet the demands of a fast-paced and dynamic work environment. Adaptable to quickly changing priorities.
Demonstrated experience managing people with a wide range of educational backgrounds and skills. Demonstrated management and conflict resolution skills to effectively lead and motivate others. Demonstrated experience in training others in the field of research.
Demonstrates good problem-solving and analytical skills. Creatively addresses complex or new problems.
Strong communicator; includes verbal and written, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills. Clear and concise communicator. Ability to influence and negotiate.
Excellent interpersonal skills, including but not limited to: problem-solving, teamwork development, leadership, mentorship. Interpersonal skills to effectively motivate others. Works well with others to achieve common goals. Ability to cultivate relationships with multiple stakeholders at various levels of administration.
Ability to perform all commonly applicable functions in word processing and spreadsheet software. Effectively uses campus' clinical information and documentation application programs. Proven ability utilizing clinical trial management systems.
Skills to work collaboratively with other cross-functional teams. Ability to interface and collaborate with other members of an extended study team. Ability to influence / persuade. Proven ability to effectively coordinate and integrate programs with others in division, department, and organization.

SPECIAL CONDITIONS

Employment is subject to a criminal background check.

We believe water is more than a resource, it's a shared responsibility. As part of our Water Business Group, you’ll help shape how communities manage water for generations to come. From delivering safe drinking water and treating wastewater responsibly to developing sustainable water supplies and protecting lives and property through flood control, your work will directly support public health, environmental sustainability, and infrastructure resilience. We bring together experts across disciplines to solve complex challenges with bold thinking and technical excellence. Whether you're modernizing aging systems or pioneering innovative approaches, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. This isn’t just a job, it's a chance to lead change, drive progress, and leave a lasting legacy.

HDR is seeking a Program Manager (Water/Wastewater)
with a proven track record in the development and delivery of large water/wastewater capital programs. This role will be responsible for the delivery of integrated, technically complex, multi-year, multi-project programs with large capital value, multiple stakeholders and high public visibility. Infrastructure may include both vertical assets
, such as existing and planned water and wastewater treatment plants, reservoirs, storage tanks, and pump stations, as well as linear assets
, including existing and planned water distribution and transmission mains, force mains, tunnels, sewers, and combined sewer overflow (CSO) systems. Candidates will demonstrate a flexible and effective programmatic approach to management of all aspects of design, procurement, construction admiration and site inspections and lifecycle delivery of large capital programs, supported by HDR’s extensive team of technical and management experts.

As a Program Manager at HDR, you will have the opportunity to deliver world-class programs that create positive social, economic and environmental outcomes, leading complex, multidisciplinary teams across diverse sectors and working with key clients and stakeholders to achieve their goals.

Senior Program Manager responsibilities include:

Develop, lead and deliver large drinking water, wastewater and/or stormwater capital program(s) from planning through design and construction to final completion.
Identify and assess major program risks and develop and implement strategies to mitigate.
Work with clients to implement appropriate program technologies, including Program Management Information Systems (PMIS).
Support client in developing program and project budgets, schedules and delivery strategies.
Act as liaison between client, HDR and principal stakeholders.
Support and participate in meetings, including public meetings.
Implement effective technical and program/project management protocols, including effective program controls
Exemplify leadership and ability to work with client to implement strategic direction.
Provide leadership, direction and guidance to subordinate managers, staff and sub-consultants.
Advocate for ethical and safe working practices and implement an effective safety and quality oversight program.
Accountable for overall financial success and delivery of the program(s).

Master's Degree

AICP Certification

jobs.description:

The IC5 Lead Principal Technical Program Manager, Security, shapes and leads complex, cross-organizational security programs that strengthen product resilience, operational execution, risk management, and business outcomes.

Partners with senior management and stakeholders to align security priorities and goals, applying technical expertise in security or a related technical domain.
Leverages AI-enabled capabilities, including generative AI, large language models, and AI-enabled automation tools, to improve program planning, reporting, risk management, decision support, and execution of security programs.
Establishes scope and milestones for each aspect of a security program, aligning to the broader program plan and company security strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services.
Shapes and leads security programs and highly complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business.
Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for issues.
Shapes program improvement strategies by applying security best practices and AI-enabled capabilities, where appropriate, to drive transformational change, improve operational efficiency, and optimize processes across multiple teams.
Shapes technical and security collaboration across multiple teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and program goals.
Provides expert security and technical guidance to shape and direct AI-enabled automation of reporting, dashboards, forecasts, and models, partnering with development teams to drive innovation and support long-term technical program execution.

Technical Management and Execution - Security Strategy and Execution:

Utilizes security knowledge to identify and manage program dependencies and risks.
Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.
Shapes overall planning activities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture.
Defines and enforces delivery standards and guidelines, ensuring security, scalability, and alignment with best practices.
Develops Line of Business (LOB) strategies for change management and/or incident response to enhance operational efficiency.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

Leads the alignment of security priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership.
Establishes scope and milestones, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services.
Leads efforts to define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for LOB performance.
Develops and communicates a comprehensive and strategic communication strategy of highly complex objectives to partners and customers.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

Shapes and leads both technical and non-technical security programs and highly complex, cross-organizational security efforts impacting products and business.

Shapes and leads AI-enabled forecasting, where appropriate, for program demand, funding, and resource requirements to inform planning, prioritization, and execution
Provides guidance on developing and maintaining comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and develops risk mitigation strategies.

Partners with leadership to set service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity benchmarks aligned with long-term business goals.
Leads the deployment of change management for security programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, development, requirement changes, and support.

Program Oversight - Risk Management:

Develops plans using AI-enabled insights from cost assessments, benefits analysis, and return on investment (ROI) evaluations to improve decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.
Makes strategic security decisions, balancing business needs, technical constraints, and long-term goals.
Removes critical blockers for the program and determines optimal technical and resource options to drive the successful delivery and adoption of solutions.

Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:

Continuous Learning:

Maintains and evolves expertise in security areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing across teams, including emerging AI-enabled capabilities where appropriate. Applies new knowledge to advance organizational capabilit

jobs.title: Innovation Operations Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films, and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause, and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About The Role

The Innovation Operations team sits at the intersection of experimentation and scale — translating new ideas into reliable, operational workflows.

We’re looking for a Technical Project Manager who can own operational execution of innovation pilots and new product experiences, from intake through launch, while also getting hands-on to configure, troubleshoot, and optimize the backend environments that make those experiments real.

You will lead cross-functional projects that test and shape the future of how we launch new experiences and formats, and ensure the technical foundation, from setup to backend tooling, is ready to support that future.

This role blends strategic project execution with hands-on technical work.

Responsibilities

Technical Project Ownership

Own global operational execution for tests and new product experiences, from intake through launch
Lead cross-functional innovation pilots, partnering with Product, Engineering, Creative and Operations to scope, test, and scale new product workflows
Translate abstract or early-stage ideas into structured, executable project plans
Design repeatable workflows and operating models for new experiences
Drive operational handoff by coordinating with regional hubs and teams to support the transition from testing to productization and scaled operations
Define success criteria and readiness standards so successful experiences can scale into stable, repeatable workflows

Technical Setup & Workflow Readiness

Set up and maintain backend testing environments
Ensure test environments and workflows can support new and non-standard experiences, and work with engineering to flag compatibility issues across tooling, delivery, and downstream workflows.
Partner with cross-functional teams to support testing and validation of new product and tech capabilities
Pressure-test workflows before launch to surface gaps in tooling, ownership, and handoffs
Lead launch readiness and post-launch validation, confirming new experiences work as intended

Problem Solving & Risk Management

Identify and resolve cross-functional blockers, technical risks, and system dependencies across engineering, ops, and tooling to keep tests on track and protect timelines, scalability, and member experience
Serve as a technical liaison between engineering and ops, ensuring clarity around scope, ownership, and trade-offs
Run intake for new tests and requests, prioritizing based on business impact and team capacity

Stakeholder Influence & Communication

Communicate project status, technical risks, and priorities clearly across cross-functional teams through concise updates, structured memos, and live forums to drive alignment and informed decision-making
Build trust and influence across engineering, product, and leadership teams by representing Innovation Operations with confidence, clarity, and the ability to advocate effectively in high-stakes or cross-functional settings

Requirements

7+ years of technical project or program management experience, ideally in high-growth, cross-functional environments
Experience managing complex technical workflows and programs with hands-on technical involvement (e.g., QA setups, test configuration, backend environments)
Proven ability to build structure in ambiguous, 0-to-1 spaces, taking a process from nothing to a scaled, repeatable operation, including defining handoffs to other teams
Experience owning launch execution and validation, including readiness checks, go/no-go decisions, and post-launch follow-up
Strong prioritization judgment, including how to balance competing requests and manage scope, and the ability to ramp quickly across different product areas
Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate workflows or improve operational efficiency
Ability to distill complexity into clear plans and articulate trade-offs, with a strong eye for edge cases and operational impact of variability across products and workflows
Exceptional written and verbal communication, from clear memos, proposals, and post-mortems to leading high-stakes conversations and building trust across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Bonus Experience

Experience launching new product features or experiences, with exposure to personalization and experimentation
Experience in testing or launching AI-powered features or products
Experience working across regions or partnering with regional teams to enable local execution
Familiarity with experimentation frameworks and agile testing of new product experiences

jobs.title: Software Development Program Manager
jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Program Manager to join a fast-paced software development organization delivering solutions for some of AMD’s key customers. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and program execution, partnering across development, firmware, hardware, manufacturing, and business teams to drive successful customer programs from requirements through delivery.

The team works in an environment that increasingly leverages AI-assisted code development to accelerate software solutions. In this highly visible role, you will work directly with engineering teams and customers to understand requirements, establish execution plans, manage software deliverables, identify and mitigate risks, and keep complex programs moving forward.

This is an opportunity to work across technologies and organizations, build relationships throughout AMD and with customers, and play an important role in delivering the software and technology that enable next-generation computing and AI solutions.

The Person

You are a self-directed, highly collaborative program leader who is comfortable operating in a complex and dynamic engineering environment. You can move comfortably between technical discussions, customer conversations, and executive-level communication while keeping teams aligned on priorities and deliverables.

You bring strong analytical, problem-solving, presentation, and risk-management skills, along with a high level of ownership and attention to detail. You know how to build relationships across teams, influence without direct authority, navigate differing viewpoints, and drive issues toward resolution.

You are also curious about evolving technology and comfortable working with software teams that incorporate AI-assisted development tools into their workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Define, plan, and drive software projects and program plans in partnership with engineering, program leadership, and customers.
Partner with customers to understand platform and software requirements and translate those needs into actionable engineering plans, schedules, and deliverables.
Drive software releases and customer program deliverables while coordinating dependencies across software, firmware, hardware, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams.
Create and maintain program management artifacts, including schedules, resource forecasts, risk and issue logs, action plans, and program status reporting.
Identify technical and program risks early, develop mitigation strategies, and drive cross-functional teams toward resolution.
Facilitate communication and alignment across development teams, customers, business units, product management, and other key stakeholders.
Collect, analyze, organize, and communicate program performance data through dashboards, status reports, and executive-level updates.
Identify opportunities to improve existing processes, team efficiency, communication, and program execution.
Build strong working relationships across the organization and create alignment among teams with competing priorities or perspectives.
Develop a strong understanding of the team’s software development environment, customers, products, and processes, progressing toward independent ownership of programs and customer deliverables.

Preferred Experience

Strong understanding of software development, software design principles, and the software development lifecycle.
Technical program management experience supporting software development and customer-facing programs.
Experience managing software releases, engineering schedules, dependencies, deliverables, risks, and issues.
Experience working in cross-functional or matrixed engineering organizations.
Strong customer relationship management skills with the ability to translate customer needs into actionable engineering requirements.
Experience collaborating with software engineering, firmware, hardware, manufacturing, product management, and business teams.
Familiarity with AI-assisted software or code development environments and tools.
Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and risk-management skills.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical teams and executive-level stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and drive teams toward decisions and execution.
Strong sense of ownership with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Office Suite, or similar productivity and program management tools.
Familiarity with hardware technologies and manufacturing processes is a plus.
People management experience is desirable.

Academic Credentials

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.
Formal project management education or certifications such as PMP or Scrum Master are desired.

Job Responsibilities:

Build relationships throughout the organization to encourage Digital Enablement engagement and provide support to internal customers.
Own portfolio performance reporting and executive-level insights that enable informed decisions regarding project health, resource capacity, risks, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
Manage the portfolio, program, and project management process to ensure it runs effectively and smoothly.

Drive accountability across project teams by tracking commitments, following up on deliverables, escalating risks when appropriate, and ensuring action items are completed within agreed timelines.
Work as a team to manage programs and projects according to instituted methodologies which utilize elements of PMI, Lean, Agile, and Theory of Constraints.

Assist in the administrative management, configuration, adoption, and continuous improvement of Wabash's Project Portfolio Management tools and applications, including Planview.

5+ years Information Technology
5+ years project management experience
Knowledge of PMI and Agile project management framework,
Knowledge of project management methodologies, to include Agile Scrum, Waterfall, Lean & Six Sigma, PRINCE2, and Theory of Constraints.
Excellent judgment and decisions making skills

Critical thinking and problem-solving skills

jobs.title: IT & Security Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

The physical and digital worlds are merging. Vehicles, medical devices, industrial systems, critical infrastructure: security hasn't kept pace. AI is accelerating everything, from the capabilities of the systems we depend on to the sophistication of the threats targeting them. A software vulnerability can now have physical consequences. A physical breach can compromise entire digital ecosystems. Billions of devices operate with little to no protection, and traditional approaches can't keep up. Not at this scale, not at this speed, and not across this diversity of systems.

Exein exists to solve this. We build the security layer for a world where physical and digital threats are no longer separate problems, from kernel-level runtime protection on embedded devices to cloud-native platforms that analyze, protect, and prove compliance across entire device fleets. We're not patching the old model. We're building security from the core out.

About The Role

We are looking for an IT & Security Manager
to own our IT environment and help us build strong security and compliance foundations.

This is a hands-on, mid-level role
at the intersection of IT operations and cybersecurity. Day to day, you will run and improve our Linux systems
, manage our Google Workspace
environment and our devices through MDM
, and put in place the security controls, policies and processes that keep the company protected and audit-ready.

Compliance is a key part of the job.
You will support audits and certification activities such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2
, maintaining evidence, documentation and remediation plans, and handling security questionnaires from customers, partners and investors. A background in cybersecurity is strongly valued.

You will have real ownership from day one, direct access to leadership, and room to grow your scope as the company scales. If you are a sharp, curious IT or security professional with solid technical foundations and a practical, proactive attitude, we would love to hear from you.

What You Will Do

IT Operations

Manage and improve our IT infrastructure, Linux systems and internal tools
Administer Google Workspace, including identity, access and security settings
Manage endpoints and devices through our MDM solution, including onboarding and offboarding
Handle IT assets, licenses and SaaS subscriptions, and work with IT vendors
Support backup and business continuity processes

Cybersecurity

Implement and maintain security controls across systems, devices, applications and cloud
Manage access control, authentication and the user lifecycle
Monitor vulnerabilities and contribute to risk management
Support security incident response
Promote security awareness across the team

Compliance & Audits

Maintain IT and security policies, procedures and documentation
Collect evidence and support internal and external audits and certification activities (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2)
Track remediation actions through to completion
Support security questionnaires from customers, partners and investors

Requirements

Past experience in IT operations, systems administration or information security, ideally in a startup or tech company
Solid hands-on knowledge of Linux systems
Hands-on experience with MDM solutions
Experience administering Google Workspace
Cybersecurity background (strongly preferred)
Experience with compliance, audits or certifications, such as contributing to policies, evidence collection or audit activities
Autonomous and proactive, with good problem-solving skills
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues
Fluent English, written and spoken

Nice to Have

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
Exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST or CIS, or certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Security+
Familiarity with GDPR
Previous experience in a startup or scale-up or in a Cybersecurity environment
