EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions helping industrial, infrastructure and defense customers address critical power and operational needs. The company delivers integrated solutions that combine energy storage technologies, power electronics, software-enabled intelligence, technical expertise and comprehensive global customer support. EnerSys supports customers across communications networks, data centers, energy infrastructure, material handling, transportation, aerospace and defense — including applications where power continuity is essential. Serving customers in more than 100 countries, EnerSys helps organizations manage energy more reliably, efficiently and intelligently in complex operating environments where uptime, safety and resilience matter.

Job Purpose

The Project Manager, Infrastructure & Cybersecurity, will be responsible for the end-to-end management of IT infrastructure and cybersecurity initiatives as part of the development of a state-of-the-art Lithium Gigafactory in alignment with EnerSys Corporate IT standards. This role is essential for ensuring the reliable, secure, and scalable foundation of the factory’s operations, from the initial build-out of network systems to the ongoing protection of critical data and operational technology.

The ideal candidate will possess both technical expertise and project management skills to oversee the planning, design, and implementation of all IT infrastructure and cybersecurity measures, in close collaboration with the factory’s operational needs, corporate standards and industry best practices. The Project Manager will work closely with internal teams, vendors, and external partners to deliver a robust, secure digital environment that supports advanced manufacturing technologies.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Infrastructure Design & Implementation

Lead the planning, development, and deployment of the factory’s IT infrastructure, including network systems, data centers, cloud architecture, and operational technology.
Coordinate the design and installation of wired and wireless network systems, servers, storage, and backup solutions to support 24/7 factory operations.
Ensure infrastructure scalability to support growth and future digitalization needs, including IoT, Industry 4.0, and automation platforms.

Cybersecurity Strategy & Execution

Support the development and implementation of a comprehensive cybersecurity strategy for the factory, protecting both IT systems and operational technology (OT) from external and internal threats.
Lead initiatives to establish secure access controls, firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and other security tools in alignment with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to implement cybersecurity measures that support advanced manufacturing technologies, including AI, robotics, and automation systems.

Project Planning & Management

Develop detailed project plans for both infrastructure and cybersecurity components, outlining milestones, deliverables, risk mitigation, and resource requirements.
Manage cross-functional project teams, ensuring collaboration between IT, operations, and external partners to meet project timelines and objectives.
Track project progress, adjust schedules and resources as needed, and provide regular status updates to senior management and key stakeholders.

Cyber Risk Management & Compliance

Assess cyber risks related to the factory’s IT and OT environments, implementing mitigation strategies to reduce vulnerabilities) in collaboration with the corporate cybersecurity group
Ensure compliance with industry standards, data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and other cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001) in collaboration with the corporate cybersecurity group
Support regular security audits, penetration testing, and vulnerability assessments to validate the effectiveness of implemented cybersecurity measures.

Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination

Work closely with external vendors and service providers to select, procure, and implement appropriate technologies for infrastructure and cybersecurity.
Act as the primary point of contact for communication with third-party vendors, ensuring that contractual obligations, SLAs, and security requirements are met.
Facilitate coordination between IT, operations, legal, and senior leadership teams to align project goals with broader business objectives.

Budget Management

Develop and manage project budgets for infrastructure and cybersecurity initiatives, ensuring cost-effective solutions while maintaining high standards of performance and security.
Monitor expenditures and adjust budgets as necessary to meet financial goals without compromising security or operational integrity.

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

Establish and maintain disaster recovery (DR) and business continuity (BC) plans for the factory’s IT and OT environments, ensuring minimal disruption to operations in the event of an incident.
Oversee the testing and refinement of DR/BC plans to ensure effectiveness and rapid recovery.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field.
CISSP, CISM, PMP, or similar cybersecurity and project management certifications preferred.

Experience

Minimum of 7 years of experience in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity, preferably in a manufacturing or high-tech environment.
Proven track record of managing infrastructure projects and implementing cybersecurity frameworks for critical systems.
Experience with IT/OT convergence, cloud services, industrial control systems (ICS), and network security in a factory setting.

Skills

In-depth knowledge of network architecture, cybersecurity tools, protocols, and standards (e.g., firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS).
Excellent project management skills, including scheduling, budgeting, and risk management.
Familiarity with compliance requirements, such as NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR, and industry-specific standards for manufacturing.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, able to translate technical needs into business objectives.
Problem-solving mindset with a focus on cybersecurity innovation and operational resilience.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
About The Team

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have

C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What We Look For

Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. jobs.description:
Summary

This role is dedicated to analyzing cyber threats through the lens of specific industry sectors, delivering context-rich threat intelligence that aligns technical findings with sector technologies, processes, regulations, and business impact.

Job Description

The analyst translates complex technical intelligence—including eCrime and APT activity—into actionable security and risk insights, sector-relevant risk narratives, and executive-aligned guidance, empowering customers to make informed decisions for their industry environment. They own the end-to-end creation of industry-focused threat intelligence reports, synthesizing internal telemetry, finished intelligence, and OSINT to provide comprehensive, sector-specific assessments.

Meet the Team

ESET Research is a team of 30+ researchers all over the world who analyze complex cyber-espionage and cybercrime operations. We work in collaboration with other internal teams to improve ESET products and create resilient malware detections.

Our primary goal is to understand how threat groups operate in order to better protect our customers and disrupt malicious activities. We write private reports that are available to ESET Threat Intelligence customers.

We share our knowledge publicly on ESET’s blog, https://www.welivesecurity.com/research/, and at technical conferences all around the world (Virus Bulletin, Black Hat, RSA, Botconf, etc.).

About The Role

Industry-focused threat intelligence

Identify, track and document APT and eCrime actors that are relevant and active in the given sectors. Analyze cyber threats, attacker behavior, campaigns, and trends as they specifically impact these sectors.
Assess vulnerabilities, technologies, and architectures commonly used in the sector and their exposure to current threats.

Intelligence collection

Continuously monitor OSINT sources, including:
Security research and vulnerability disclosures affecting sector-relevant technology stacks
Publications from sector organizations, government entities, and regulators
Broader industry trends, geopolitical factors, and other developments impacting cyber risk
Collaborate closely with in-house Threat Intelligence teams to understand current technical findings, campaigns, and telemetry-based observations.
Work with strategic/geopolitical analysts to integrate broader context into sector threat assessments.

Intelligence reporting and analysis

Produce regular industry-focused intelligence reports combining curated and contextualized OSINT in addition to our proprietary intelligence, derived from ESET telemetry and internal research.
Move beyond isolated cases by identifying, documenting, and explaining sector-specific trends and patterns.
Clearly articulate operational and business impact relevant to the industry audience.

Other Responsibilities

Act as a subject-matter expert for internal teams, including sales, customer success, and marketing, providing sector-specific threat context. Serve as a bridge between technical Threat Intelligence analysts and customer-facing or business teams. Support sector-specific positioning of Threat Intelligence offerings.
Deliver threat intelligence briefings to existing and prospective customers within the assigned sectors.
Represent the company at industry-focused cybersecurity conferences and events.

Essential Requirements

Possess a strong background in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or cybersecurity operations, and demonstrate the ability to analyze cyber threats beyond purely technical indicators.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Demonstrated ability to produce concise, actionable reports that clearly communicate research findings and recommendations, ensuring relevance and impact for industry stakeholders.
Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to present complex threat intelligence also to non-technical/executive audiences.

Desirable Requirements

Prior experience working within a specific industry sector, preferably as threat intelligence analyst, SOC analyst, internal security professional or similar role.
Understanding of regulatory and compliance environments relevant to critical industries (e.g. NIST, NIS2, ISO 27001).
Experience presenting at conferences or delivering customer briefings.

jobs.description:
Job Title:
Compliance Program Manager

Company:
AISIN World Corp. of America

Department:
General Administration, Legal Affairs Department

Location:
Northville, MI

Position Summary

AISIN World Corp. of America ("AWA"), a global Tier-1 automotive supplier, is seeking a Compliance Program Manager to join our Legal Affairs Department.

This position brings the compliance program to the people who do the work. You will build and deliver compliance training, roll out new policies across more than 30 companies in the United States, Canada, and Mexico, and promote the program so more than 15,000 team members understand the standards, why they matter, and how to raise a concern.

The successful candidate brings at least five years of compliance experience and communicates equally effectively on the plant floor and in the executive suite. You are organized, you follow through, and you can analyze program data and explain what it means.

A law degree is not required, though an attorney would be well suited to this role. Our attorneys handle legal advice, legal risk, the compliance hotline, and investigations. Your focus is to build the program, operate it, and establish it across our plants and offices.

The position requires approximately 25% travel to our sites in the United States, Mexico, and Canada. We welcome candidates who want to grow into a global compliance leadership role.

Position Responsibilities

The Compliance Program Manager is expected to perform the following three core functions that the company has determined are essential to this position:

Compliance Program Ownership and Network Leadership

Run the day-to-day operation of the North American compliance program. It covers more than 30 companies in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The program and all materials are delivered in English, Spanish, and Japanese.
Be the main contact for compliance program questions from our companies and from Japan headquarters. Send legal questions to Legal Affairs.
Lead the network of Compliance Officers and Compliance Managers at each company. They do not report to you. You lead them through trust, clear standards, and follow-up.
Deliver standard training to every Compliance Officer and Compliance Manager. Cover their duties, including Code of Conduct work, policy rollout, training delivery, and when to escalate. Teach in person and online, track 100% completion, and maintain the records.
Visit plants and offices to see how the program is working. Meet with local leaders and team members, and share your observations with Legal Affairs.
Work with the Japan headquarters compliance team. This includes weekly calls on the status of compliance activities and promoting compliance materials.
Some calls may be late at night or early in the morning.

Report program status and results to the General Counsel, Senior Counsel, senior management, and Japan headquarters management. Reporting is ongoing and driven by need, not only on a fixed schedule.
Write the annual compliance program report and recommend the program priorities for the next fiscal year.

Training, Communication, and Culture

Manage the Code of Conduct program. This includes annual training, new hire onboarding, and updates. Legal Affairs reviews and approves all content before release.
Plan, schedule, and deliver annual training on compliance topics, policies, and procedures across the company:
Code of Conduct
Antitrust
Anti-corruption and bribery
Other compliance topics identified for the year
Executive, management, and Compliance Officer training

Plan and track training across all locations and employee groups, and drive completion to the annual target.
Build compliance campaigns and materials that work for a plant floor audience. This includes posters, short messages, and site events.
Have all materials translated into Spanish and Japanese. Check the translations before they go out.
Speak to senior leaders, HR groups, company compliance meetings, and Japan headquarters as the region's expert on the compliance program.
Run the annual compliance survey from start to finish. Study the results and present what you found and what to do about it to Legal Affairs and senior management.

Policy Rollout and Program Support

Maintain the regional compliance policy library.
Work with each company to put the regional policies in place and track them through to completion.
Roll out approved policies and procedures across the company. Legal Affairs writes the policies. You take them to the organizations and ensure adoption.
Prepare the proposal for senior management approval.
Explain the change across a large network of companies.
Build and deliver training for office and plant employees.

Own the compliance program records for the region. This includes training completion, policy sign-offs, and site visit records. Keep the data accurate and audit-ready.
Support compliance technology projects, including self-service and AI tools. Verify content accuracy before release, and monitor tool usage.
Manage compliance program vendors, including training platforms and translation providers. Watch service levels, scheduling, invoices, and performance.
Help Legal Affairs manage outside law firms on compliance matters. This includes scheduling, collecting documents, tracking status, and tracking budget. Legal Affairs hires and directs outside counsel.

Perform other duties and tasks assigned. This job description is not intended to be a complete list of all responsibilities, and duties may change as business needs require.

Required Skills And Abilities

Essential Skills and Experience:

ABILITY TO PROJECT-MANAGE LARGE-SCALE COMPLIANCE ROLLOUTS AND PROJECTS REQUIRED
No less than 5 years of proven experience in compliance or ethics.
No less than 5 years of proven experience promoting, rolling out, and building support for a company compliance program.
Must be a dynamic speaker and presenter; a people person. You will present to large groups regularly.
Proven ability to lead and get results from people who do not report to you.
Experience building training and teaching live to large, mixed groups, including hourly plant employees.
Ability to pull, study, and explain program data, such as training completion rates and survey results.
Skilled in PowerPoint and able to present ideas clearly.
Strong communication skills in speaking, writing, and presenting. Effective with senior executives and with plant floor employees.
Able to work on your own and take initiative.
Strong organization and time management skills, with close attention to detail.
Proven ability to drive open items to completion across many sites and time zones.

Beneficial Skills And Experience

Experience promoting compliance activities to a plant workforce.
Experience training and teaching a workforce about compliance.
Experience promoting compliance materials in more than one language, including checking translation quality.
Working knowledge of Spanish or Japanese.
Experience at a Japanese-parented company or another company with a foreign headquarters.
Experience running a learning management system or other compliance records system.
Experience with compliance technology, including self-service or AI tools.
Experience visiting or auditing manufacturing sites.

Education/Training/Certifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.
Certified Compliance and Ethics Professional (CCEP or CCEP-I) preferred. If you are not certified, you must earn it within 12 months of hire. The company will pay for study materials and the exam.
A law degree is not required, but it is a plus.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Business Overview

The Marketing Division leads brand, creative,marketing, and membership as a cross-group organization with a mission to expand Rakuten Group's membership value and ecosystem of over 70 services.

We believe that the mobile domain is a platform that plays a fundamental role in the ecosystem, and as the Marketing Division, we are further promoting collaboration with Rakuten Mobile.

Department Overview

We will increase the number of new Rakuten Mobile subscribers in the web marketing area and promote expansion of market share.

We collaborate with Rakuten Group media (Rakuten Ichiba, Rakuten Travel, Rakuten Card, Rakuten Pay, etc.) to plan, implement, and analyze web marketing strategies to acquire new Rakuten Mobile customers.

The Planning & Analysis Section, for which we are currently recruiting, has the most important mission of acquiring new Rakuten Mobile subscribers. We consistently promote the planning, execution, and analysis of web marketing strategies by making maximum use of the vast amount of data owned by the Rakuten Group and diverse internal and external channels of the Rakuten Group.

Specifically, We Comprehensively Cover The Following Areas

Digital Marketing Domain:
We utilize major digital media outside the Rakuten Group (listing ads, display ads, affiliates, SEO, etc.) to plan strategies, execute measures, and measure effects for acquiring new Rakuten Mobile subscribers.

Rakuten Group Internal Domain:
We work closely with the diverse media and customer assets of over 70 Rakuten Group services such as Rakuten Ichiba, Rakuten Travel, Rakuten Card, and Rakuten Pay to promote web marketing strategies that maximize synergy.

In this department, we integrate and analyze data obtained from these broad channels to design and execute precise marketing measures based on a deep understanding of user behavior, thereby powerfully driving the growth of Rakuten Mobile.

Position

Why We Hire

Data utilization is indispensable for marketing activities aimed at acquiring Rakuten Mobile line subscribers. To further strengthen the construction and utilization of a data foundation for more advanced data analysis and sophisticated ad delivery control both internally and externally at Rakuten, we are recruiting additional data analysts. This position will play a crucial role in leveraging abundant data and the latest technology to deepen customer understanding and drive business growth through optimization of measures.

Position Details

In this position, you will promote data utilization to maximize the acquisition of mobile line subscriptions within Rakuten Mobile's marketing department. You will lead a series of processes from integrating and analyzing diverse data sources, deriving insights directly linked to business impact, to translating them into actionable measures.

Problem Solving through Data Aggregation and Analysis

Data analysis utilizing the vast user data and behavior logs of the Rakuten Group, and a robust data analysis environment (BigQuery, Databricks, BI tools, etc.)
Data analysis and improvement proposals for acquiring mobile line subscriptions
Effect estimation and verification for new service introductions
Promotion of hyper-personalization for marketing measures

Building Data Linkage Infrastructure for Internal/External Tools (KARTE, SalesForce, LINE, etc.)

Designing and planning for hyper-personalization
Building and optimizing machine learning and AI models with specialized departments

Designing, Building, and Operating Dashboards

Data processing using BigQuery/BI tools (DOMO Tableau, Looker, etc.), dashboard design, construction, automation, and development of KPI monitoring infrastructure

Proposing Analysis Results and Supporting Decision Making

Supporting ad-hoc data extraction and hypothesis testing
Structurally organizing analysis results as a story and presenting proposals and reports through documents and presentations
Collaborating with diverse stakeholders (marketing personnel, development teams, etc.) to provide proposals and decision-making support based on quantitative insights

Work Environment

Our organization is a team within the Rakuten Mobile marketing department, dedicated to acquiring new line subscribers through data utilization. Comprising three data analysts and two data scientists, primarily in their 20s and 30s, each member enjoys significant autonomy and influence, fostering a fast-paced environment for challenging work. We cultivate a culture that constantly embraces new technologies and analytical methods, prioritizing data-driven decision-making.

Attractions

Forefront of Data/AI Utilization: We are promoting AI utilization company-wide, and you can gain work experience by combining Rakuten's abundant data.
Impact on Business Contribution: The insights you derive will have a direct impact on the core of Rakuten Mobile's business, which is the acquisition of line subscriptions, making this a rewarding position where you can feel the results of your work.
Collaboration with Experts: There are many data science and AI experts within the company, and you can improve your skills by collaborating with them.

Mandatory Qualifications

Practical experience of approximately 3 years or more in data extraction, processing, and aggregation using SQL.
Practical experience of 3 years or more in data processing on BigQuery, and data processing, data analysis, and dashboard construction using BI tools (Tableau, Looker, DOMO, etc.).
Experience in autonomously designing hypotheses, structuring analysis, and designing analysis to solve business problems.
Experience in structuring analysis results as a story and presenting them in documents and presentations.
Experience in collaborating with various stakeholders and providing proposals and decision-making support based on quantitative insights.

Desired Qualifications

Practical experience in data analysis within a marketing department (e.g., measuring the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, optimizing digital advertising, data analysis for CRM initiatives).
Business-level English proficiency.
Understanding of cookies and tracking technologies.
Conceptual understanding, practical experience, or tool usage experience with generative AI, machine learning, and deep learning.
Practical experience in data analysis, visualization, and machine learning using Python or R.
Practical experience utilizing basic statistical knowledge (e.g., mean, variance, population/sample, hypothesis testing).
Knowledge and implementation experience of statistical models (e.g., logistic regression, clustering, factor analysis).
Experience in promoting dashboard usage and supporting data utilization in user departments (e.g., data literacy education, explanatory meetings).

As a Data Analyst, Procurement – MRO, you will serve as the analytics engine for the North American Maintenance, Repair & Operations (MRO) category. You will transform sourcing, supplier, inventory, and plant maintenance data into actionable insights that improve cost, working capital, supplier performance, contract compliance as well as increase our speed of decision making and sourcing execution. You will partner with Category Buyers, Category Managers, Maintenance Leaders, Plant Stakeholders, Finance Stakeholders, Master Data Management team, IT, and suppliers to identify value opportunities, build repeatable analytical tools, quantify and validate savings, and strengthen the foundational data required to execute the MRO category strategy. The ideal candidate combines technical analytics capability, procurement and manufacturing business acumen, and the ability to support stakeholder decision making.

Job Description

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Develop and maintain spend analytics across MRO categories, suppliers, plants, materials, and buying channels (SAP, Ariba catalog and non-catalog).
Clean, enrich, classify, and reconcile purchasing data, supplier invoices, catalog, contract, inventory, and material master data.
Identify savings opportunities through price variance analysis, supplier consolidation, demand aggregation, tail-spend analysis, specification alignment, and sourcing opportunity sizing.
Build item-level pricing benchmarks using supplier quotations, distributor catalogs, transaction history, RFP data, and market information.
Analyze supplier price changes, inflation requests, freight, surcharges, and tariff claims; document assumptions and assist with simplifying complex data to enable decision making.
Analyze inventory consumption trends, stock levels, inventory turns, excess and obsolete materials, duplicate items, and standardization opportunities to support working-capital improvement.
Partner with maintenance and plant stakeholders to validate material usage, criticality, substitution potential, and site-specific requirements.
Develop supplier scorecards and track cost, quality, service, delivery, continuity, and contract-performance metrics.
Support strategic sourcing events by preparing baselines, supplier bid files, bid-comparison models, scenario analyses, award recommendations, and implementation tracking within the Ariba sourcing tool or other available tools.
Monitor catalog utilization, preferred-supplier adoption, leakage spend analysis and off-contract purchasing; identify corrective actions and measure results.
Help create and enhance dashboards and automated reporting for supplier spend, project pipeline, savings, inventory, supplier performance, and sourcing execution.
Establish transparent savings calculations, maintain initiative-level documentation, and partner with Finance for validation.
Continuously improve analytical processes, reporting cadence, data controls, and documentation to reduce manual work and increase repeatability.

Key Performance Outcomes

Helping plants get the right parts and services at the right cost by providing spend cube visibility, data completeness, taxonomy classification accuracy, and timely reporting
Supporting a large, business-critical category by enabling analytics and visibility across hundreds of millions of dollars in MRO spend, supplier relationships, inventory management, and maintenance services that keep manufacturing operations running.
Creating the backbone of category strategy through data by transforming fragmented sourcing, supplier, inventory, and maintenance information enabling insights into supplier consolidation opportunities, inventory optimization, pricing transparency, and measurable savings delivery.

Required

Expected Experience & Required Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Engineering, Finance, Business, Economics, or a related discipline.
3+ years of experience in analytics, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, finance, operations, or a related field.
Advanced Excel capability, including data modeling, Power Query, fuzzy logic, pivot table, scenario analysis, and structured analytical methods.
Experience working with large, imperfect datasets and reconciling information across multiple sources.
Ability to simplify complex data to enable decision making
Strong problem-solving, project management, communication, and stakeholder-partnership skills.

Preferred

Experience supporting MRO, manufacturing, maintenance, engineering, industrial distribution, or indirect procurement.
Experience with SAP, Ariba, Power BI, SQL, Python, Alteryx, or comparable analytics platforms.
Understanding of sourcing, contracting, supplier management, inventory optimization, material master data, and procurement savings methodologies.
Experience developing automated dashboards, repeatable data pipelines, and executive-level performance reporting.

Data-driven decision making and intellectual curiosity.
Ownership, accountability, and disciplined follow-through.
Business partnership and influence without authority.
Continuous improvement and simplification mindset.
Strategic thinking with strong attention to detail.
Results orientation and ability to manage competing priorities.

Partnership: Work closely with colleagues across Capital One Credit Risk Management, Finance and other teams to drive effective oversight of loss forecasts
Execution: Help to develop, enhance and implement sustainable processes to identify, communicate, and document challenges to the loss estimation approaches and their resolution
Strategic & analytic orientation: A proven track record of problem solving based on analytics. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation, given that a large part of the role is based on rigorous analytic credit risk management
Strong judgment, leadership and integrity: Be able to prioritize among competing priorities while bringing a healthy, diligent, yet empathetic approach to the oversight function
Strong communication skills: Great written and oral communication credentials, coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal and negotiation skills

About the Role:

The Senior Business Analyst for Commercial Operations will serve as a strategic analytics partner to the commercial organization, translating complex data into actionable insights that improve sales effectiveness, forecasting accuracy, customer profitability, pricing discipline, and overall commercial performance. This role partners closely with Sales, Commercial Operations, and many other cross-functional business leaders to identify trends, evaluate opportunities, solve ambiguous business problems, and support data-driven decision making.

This role will lead Commercial self-service analytics using Microsoft Power BI, working closely with Sales, Commercial Operations, Finance, and the Enterprise Data team. The analyst will define business requirements and KPI logic, develop dashboards and decision-support analyses using governed data products and shared semantic models, and help Commercial users confidently use data in day-to-day decision-making

Success in this role requires strong analytical capability, business acumen, executive-ready communication, and the ability to connect data, process, and technology to measurable commercial outcomes.

This role will be a strategic commercial decision-support partner focused on growth, profitability, customer experience, and organizational efficiency. Success in this role will be measured by improvements in commercial visibility, forecast accuracy, decision quality, process efficiency, and business performance outcomes.

Your
Responsibilities:

Commercial Analytics & Business Insights

Analyze commercial performance trends to identify risks, opportunities, gaps, and improvement actions.
Develop insights related to sales pipeline, forecasting, customer profitability, pricing, product mix, market trends, and commercial performance.
Translate complex datasets into clear business narratives, recommendations, and decision-support materials for commercial leaders.
Conduct root cause analysis to understand performance variances and recommend corrective actions.
Build governed Power BI dashboards and reports using certified enterprise data products and shared semantic models to enable self-service analytics.
Collaborate with the Enterprise Data team to transition broadly adopted analyses and business logic into governed, scalable, reusable, and automated enterprise data products.
Lead self-service analytics adoption within the Commercial organization by developing reusable Power BI solutions, training users, monitoring adoption, collecting feedback, and continuously improving the usability and business value of analytics products.

Identify opportunities to improve reporting consistency, metric definitions, data quality, and performance visibility.
Partner with Sales and Operations stakeholders to improve forecast visibility, demand accuracy, and alignment to business needs.

Leverage tools such as Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Salesforce CRM, SQL, and ERP platforms to develop meaningful reporting and analytics.
Partner with IT and business users to improve data access, dashboard usability, system functionality, and reporting automation.
Serve as the bridge between Commercial stakeholders and the Enterprise Data team: partner with the business to define priorities, requirements, and KPI logic, and collaborate with the Data team to deliver governed data, scalable dashboards, and automated reporting solutions.
Drive self-service analytics across the Commercial organization by improving the adoption and effective use of data, dashboards, and analytics tools.
Help identify and prioritize technology and automation opportunities that improve commercial productivity, user adoption, and decision support capabilities.
Apply advanced analytics techniques where appropriate to improve forecasting, segmentation, profitability analysis, and commercial decision support.

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

Build strong working relationships with the Commercial team and other cross-functional partners.
Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Prepare concise, leadership-ready materials that summarize insights, options, and recommended actions.
Support additional commercial operations priorities and projects as assigned.
Other duties as assigned

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Analytics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field. (MBA preferred)

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets, identify trends, and convert insights into actionable business recommendations.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, and data modeling. Experience developing interactive dashboards and reporting solutions in Power BI.
Experience working with CRM, ERP, or other enterprise data systems.
Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis strongly preferred
Experience identifying process improvement opportunities and implementing solutions that improve efficiency, data quality, decision-making, or business performance.
Experience developing KPIs, scorecards, forecasting models, or performance management frameworks that support business accountability and decision-making.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect analytics to commercial performance, profitability, customer experience, and operational execution.
Ability to synthesize complex data into clear business insights, recommendations, and executive-level narratives that drive action.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, work through ambiguity, and deliver high-quality analysis with attention to detail.
Demonstrated ability to influence commercial decisions through insightful analysis, business acumen, and effective stakeholder partnership.
Highly detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data accuracy, governance, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
Bamboo Health is the leader in Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions aimed at improving lives for everyone experiencing physical and behavioral health challenges. We are driven by our mission to empower clients to deliver seamless, high-quality and cost-effective care during pivotal moments to improve health outcomes. From coast to coast, Bamboo Health partners with all major retail pharmacy chains, 52 states and territories, 100% of the top 10 best hospitals and more than half of the country’s largest health plans to improve more than 1 billion patient encounters annually. Join us in improving lives during pivotal care moments!

Summary

Bamboo Health is building a team of compassionate clinicians and leaders who are committed to improving care access to those in most need. We are seeking a seasoned, highly motivated Senior Project Manager who can bridge clinical, operational, and technical workstreams across provider and payor organizations. This role owns end-to-end project delivery—from initial scoping through go-live and post-launch stabilization—while consulting directly with customers on workflow design to drive results and accelerate implementation timelines. In addition to leading individual implementations, you will manage a portfolio of partner engagements, balancing competing priorities, risks, and stakeholder needs while helping scale implementation best practices across the organization. The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of project management and client success experience, deep healthcare delivery knowledge, and the judgment to work independently with minimal oversight, comfortably tailoring communication across a variety of stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

What You’ll Do

Own the full implementation lifecycle for new provider or payor partners, working independently and with minimal oversight to ensure all milestones, deliverables, and outcomes are met on time and within scope.
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for external partners, including health systems, provider networks, and payors.
Partner with customers and internal clinical and operational teams to design workflows, staffing models, referral pathways, and escalation processes that support successful implementation and accelerate time to value.
Collaborate with data integration and IT teams to enable connectivity with EHRs, care management platforms, and analytics tools.
Guide partners through workflow changes, training, and adoption planning to drive results and ensure smooth go-live transitions.
Maintain project plans and status reports, as well as risks and issues logs.
Tailor communication of progress, dependencies, and mitigation plans across audiences, from junior project managers to executive leadership, both internally and externally.
Capture lessons learned and feedback to refine implementation methodology, mentor less experienced project managers, and accelerate future rollouts.
Manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, balancing timelines, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder priorities to ensure successful delivery.
Identify repetitive tasks and partner with team leads to implement scalable automation solutions.

What Success Looks Like…

In 3 months…

Take ownership of at least one active implementation, serving as the primary customer contact while maintaining accurate status reporting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
Build strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and identify opportunities to improve workflows, processes, or implementation efficiency.
Identify at least one opportunity in your role to pilot or apply AI or automation (e.g., streamlining a task, summarizing data, generating content).

In 6 months…

Independently manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, consistently delivering key milestones on time and within scope.
Lead partners through workflow design, operational readiness, training, adoption planning, and go-live execution.
Serve as a trusted advisor to customers while mentoring less experienced project managers and contributing implementation best practices across the team.

In 12 months…

Deliver multiple successful go-lives with measurable post-launch stabilization, such as partner adoption targets met and time to value shortened compared with baseline.
Capture lessons learned across your implementations and contribute at least two lasting improvements to our implementation playbook, templates, or tools.
Be recognized as a go-to leader for complex implementations, influencing customer outcomes, supporting executive-level partner relationships, and helping elevate implementation excellence across the organization.

What You Need

Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of combined experience in healthcare project management and account/client success, preferably with exposure to behavioral health, care coordination, or population health in technology enabled services.
Proven success independently leading complex implementations or partnerships involving provider organizations, payors, or health IT vendors, with minimal oversight.
Experience with EHR integrations, referral management workflows, or value-based care initiatives strongly preferred.
A consultative, proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail.
Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex problems, and independently drive projects forward in dynamic environments.
Strongly empathetic with a keen desire to reduce barriers to behavioral health and social services for the underserved.
Ability to convey technical information and tailor communication across a range of audiences and levels, from junior project managers to clinicians, administrators, and C-level executives, exercising strong, independent judgment in what and how to communicate with customers.
PMP (Project Management Professional, PMI) is preferred.
Comfort using or learning AI-supported tools (e.g., ChatGPT, CoPilot, or role-specific tools) to improve daily workflows.
A forward-thinking, curious mindset with an openness to experimenting with new technologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment and creativity in designing solutions.
Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly evolving environments.
Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment, ensuring high-quality virtual interactions with minimal distractions.
The ability to travel periodically for work.

What You Get

Join one of the most innovative healthcare technology companies in the country.
Have the autonomy to build something with an enthusiastically supportive team.
Learn from working at the highest levels and on the most strategic priorities of the company, including from world class investors and advisors.
Receive competitive compensation, including health, dental, vision and other benefits.

Belonging at Bamboo

We Care. #BambooHealthValuesCare

Every human being has the right to the best possible healthcare. Our Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions enable healthcare professionals to see and treat every individual as a whole person by providing the right information, at the right time – regardless of physical, behavioral or social barriers.

Technical Program Leadership

Apply prior engineering and technical leadership experience to guide technical decision-making, trade studies, and issue resolution.
Translate system requirements and technical risks into executable program plans and schedules.
Serve as the primary technical and programmatic interface between engineering teams, operations, and customers.

Engineering & Cross-Functional Execution

Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams including systems engineering, hardware and software engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and test.
Chair and actively participate in technical reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR), leveraging hands-on engineering background to challenge assumptions and ensure technical rigor.
Ensure alignment between engineering design intent and manufacturing execution.

Planning, Schedule & Risk Management

Develop and maintain integrated master schedules (IMS), budgets, and resource plans tied to engineering and production milestones.
Apply earned value management (EVM) or similar performance metrics where required.
Identify, assess, and mitigate technical, cost, schedule, and supply-chain risks inherent to precision navigation and guidance systems.

Financial & Contract Management

Manage program budgets, forecasts, and cost controls to meet margin, cash, and delivery objectives.
Support proposal development, cost estimates, and schedule builds for new and follow-on Guidance & Navigation programs.
Manage contract changes, scope adjustments, and customer-directed engineering modifications.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

Act as the primary program interface to government and commercial customers, with the technical credibility to discuss system design, performance, and qualification.
Prepare and deliver program and technical status briefings to customers and Kearfott senior leadership.
Support customer audits, design reviews, and qualification activities.

Quality, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

jobs.title: Transportation Principal Project Manager
jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.

Principal Project Manager roles at HDR are considered to be the very top echelon of Project Managers in our business group, delivering the largest/most complex programs facing our clients. Additionally, the Principal Project Managers are part of our Transportation Leadership team and have a seat at the table to discuss ways to improve program delivery at the top of our organization. Ontario Line Program, SR 520 Floating Bridge, South Mountain Freeway in Arizona and Oregon Bridge Delivery Partners Program are just some of the past examples of iconic programs that HDR has delivered through the work of dedicated program teams well led by a Principal Project Manager. Come join us to work on the next generation of legendary Transportation projects.

In the role of a Principal Project Manager, we'll count on you to:

Assume leadership responsibilities for the management of multidisciplinary infrastructure programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.

Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of infrastructure programs, which are all critical to program success. Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address the specific needs of each client.

Plan, direct, and monitor all aspects of program execution. This may involve overseeing a broad range of disciplines including, but not limited to: capital planning, change management, commissioning/asset onboarding, communications, construction management, cost control/estimating, document management, environmental planning/compliance, engineering, equity, financial support, organizational strengthening, permitting, planning/design management, program governance, procurement, project management, quality management, real estate, regulatory support, risk management, scheduling, strategic planning, sustainability and resiliency.

Anticipate and identify potential issues and risks that may impact program implementation, and assist the client with problem-solving, issues resolution, risk mitigation, and timely decision-making. Provide strategic advice and thought leadership. Deploy the required resources to address various program challenges and unanticipated events.

Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.

Direct the services provided by multiple large program teams or provide day-to-day leadership on a single mega-project.

Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communications.

Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance.

Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.

Monitor the financial performance of the program against pre-established financial metrics and adjust as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets, and control losses.

Contribute to the growth of HDR’s program management services by (1) building a long-term trusted advisory relationship with clients; (2) looking for opportunities to expand our services to address the needs of existing clients; (3) supporting the pursuit of new program contract opportunities; (4) mentoring and training staff working on programs; and (5) supporting practice-wide initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sciences, Planning, Business Administration or closely related field

DBIA certification

Experience leading the consultant or owner program management team of at least one [transportation/water/resources] infrastructure program(s) with a capital value of $1 billion

Knowledgeable of other alternative delivery/contract models, such as public-private partnership (P3), design-build-finance-operate-maintain (DBFOM), and engineering procurement construction (EPC)Willingness to travel regularly, and if needed, commute to a client’s site temporarily

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sciences, Planning, Business Administration or a closely related field
At least one of the following licenses/certifications recognized by the licensing board for the location of the position offered: Professional Engineering License (PE or P.Eng), PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, PMI Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification, AICP Certification, or CMAA Certified Construction Manager (CCM) Certification
Program management experience consistent with the following requirements: A minimum of ten (10) years of program management experience, with at least four (4) years as a Senior Program Manager, and Experience leading as a Senior Program Manager or serving in a similar role on delivery of three or more programs, each with a capital value of $500 million or more, and. Experience delivering concurrent programs with a total value of $500 million or more qualifies as one of the required programs
Strong leadership skills with experience building a cohesive team culture and managing team members located in various locations
Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to client executives and in front of a large audience in a public setting
Management experience with the implementation of projects or programs using alternative and collaborative delivery methods, including design-build (DB), progressive design-build (PDB), and/or construction management at-risk (CMAR)
Familiar with the various types of tools used to manage large programs - PMIS, CMIS, scheduling, cost control, document management, risk management, asset management, dashboard analytics, etc.
Experience working in an integrated fashion within a Program Management Office (PMO) comprised of both consultant and client staff

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. jobs.description:
If you are a technology visionary with a passion for transforming global tax business with digital technology, consider working with the US Tax Transformation technology team. This is an exciting opportunity to support global execution of Deloitte's tax strategy as we shift from "doing digital" to "being digital" by reimagining how we engage with our clients, deliver our services, operate our business, and create value.

Work you'll do

As a Deloitte Tax Business Analyst, Manager you will be responsible for understanding the business needs, models, trends, and transformation vision. You will identify changes required to meet the business need by consideration of organization structure, business functions, required knowledge and skills, processes and technology. You will explore possible solutions by coordinating with technical architects for discovery and demonstrate how proposed solutions are aligned to business goals and objectives and define the impacts and risks.

Responsibilities include:

Use business goals and objectives to assist Product Owners in developing a product roadmap.
Perform business analysis tasks and/or coordinate tasks across the Service Delivery Transformation program.
Identify solution options that meet the business need, then coordinate with delivery teams to determine the best solution approach.
Assist Product Owners in defining release scope, including defining benefits and risks during the discovery phase.
Develop supporting artifacts including requirements, solution options, recommendations, business flows, where required.
Make connections with other initiatives in place, underway or planned across other parts of the organization that need to be considered.
Work with architects and delivery teams to ensure the functionality meets the needs of the enterprise and aligns to the overall vision.
Ensure the business is aware of emerging trends, practice, and technologies and how they may contribute to business outcomes and strategies.
Actively identify and champion innovation initiatives supporting the business strategy.
Develop and maintain productive and collaborative relationships with Product Owners, and various SMEs across the organization to support Service Delivery Transformation efforts.
Explore and assess applications of AI, machine learning, and automation to streamline tax business processes, generate data-driven insights, and create value for our clients.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Business-to-technology translation - Ability to explain business needs, technical concepts, emerging technologies, and solution options in clear, audience-appropriate language for both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Stakeholder collaboration and relationship building - Ability to build productive relationships with Product Owners, architects, delivery teams, subject matter experts, and business leaders to gather insights, align priorities, and support enterprise-wide transformation.
Facilitation and influence - Ability to lead discovery discussions, workshops, and working sessions; ask thoughtful questions; build consensus; and influence decisions across teams without relying solely on formal authority.
Strategic problem-solving and innovation mindset - Ability to connect business objectives to practical solution options, assess impacts and risks, recognize opportunities for AI and automation, and champion ideas that create measurable business value.

The team

Deloitte Tax LLP's Tax Transformation Office (TTO) is responsible for the design, development, and deployment of innovative, enterprise technology, tools, and standard processes to support the delivery of tax services. The TTO team focuses on enhancing Deloitte Tax LLP's ability to deliver comprehensive, value-added, and efficient tax services to our clients. It is a dynamic team with professionals of varying backgrounds from tax technical, technology development, change management, Six Sigma, and project management. The team consults and executes on a wide range of initiatives involving process and tool development and implementation including training development, engagement management, tool design, and implementation.

As a Senior Business Analyst at Capital One, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to major company challenges. You will team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact the bottom line. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

This Senior Business Analyst position sits within Commercial Risk Management’s Strategy & Analytics team, which develops and implements risk rating (underwriting) and loss forecasting models across the Commercial Bank. Serving as a key analytical lead for upcoming model builds, this position bridges quantitative modelers and senior business leaders. Analysis: Identify business challenges and opportunities for improvement and solve for them using analysis to make strategic or tactical recommendations
Product: Perform modeling/analytics to assist new product/models for various lines of business within Commercial Bank
Credit Risk: Support step-change improvements in credit performance by connecting drivers of future consumer and commercial credit trends to historical behavior, creating risk models, and testing hypotheses using rigorous monitoring and analysis

Partnership: Work closely with colleagues across Capital One including: Model Development, Credit Officers, Underwriters, Relationship Managers, Finance and others to drive improvement in our credit risk modeling
Strategic & analytic orientation: A proven track record of decision making and problem solving based on analytics. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation, given that a large part of the business is based on rigorous analytics & credit risk management

to provide Advisory and Assistance Services (A&AS) in support of research and development programs. The Technical Project Manager will develop program plans and acquisition strategies, monitor cost, schedule, and performance, prepare execution reports and briefings, and provide programmatic advice to support long-range planning and successful program outcomes.

Provide program management Advisory and Assistance Services (A&AS), including general program management and Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) support for research and development programs in accordance with DoD Directive 5000.01.
Develop program plans, acquisition strategies, and procurement documents.
Support the design of the program to meet capability gaps.

Prepare and maintain program management execution reports.
Author correspondence, program briefings, and related products.
Support overall management of R&D projects related to cost, schedule, and performance.
Provide general programmatic advice regarding research and development plans and execution.
Support long-range planning.
Develop and maintain monthly and annual task status reports, dashboards, and escalation protocols.
Support strategic planning and policy development.
All other duties as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree in management, business, or engineering.
5+ years of experience in DoD program planning and program management across the Defense Acquisition Life Cycle.
At least 5–7 years of experience in DoD Research, Development, Testing and Evaluation (RDT&E) management.
Experience with DoD acquisition methods.
Experience with DoD PPBE processes.
Counter Weapons of Mass Destruction (CWMD) mission or technical knowledge.
Analytical research experience, including assessing threats and conducting market research.
Outstanding Microsoft Office skills.

Master’s degree in management, business, science, or engineering.

DoD weapons development, test, and evaluation experience.
Experience in Counter-Weapons of Mass Destruction (C-WMD) R&D.
Previous experience at the Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA).

new_jobs.description:
Sektor finansowy w ponad 30-letniej historii firmy Comarch ma na swoim koncie tysiące zrealizowanych projektów na całym świecie! Nasza oferta sprawia, że wyróżniamy się wśród najbardziej prężnych dostawców systemów informatycznych i oprogramowania finansowego. Wysoka jakość, doskonała wydajność oraz duża elastyczność naszych rozwiązań pozwalają przedsiębiorstwom na efektywne zarządzanie swoimi finansami. Realizujemy zadania od projektowania, programowania, testowania aż do momentu wdrożenia systemu w oparciu o najnowsze technologie.

Wykształcenie wyższe o profilu informatycznym, ekonomicznym lub pokrewnym
Co najmniej 4 lata doświadczenia w prowadzeniu projektów IT
Znajomość metodyk prowadzenia projektów informatycznych oraz narzędzi wspomagających zarządzanie projektami, np.: Jira, MS Project
Pierwsze doświadczenia w zarządzaniu ludźmi lub silne predyspozycje liderskie (rola przewiduje rozwój w kierunku kierownika subcentrum)

Zdolność pracy w zespole, oraz budowania i utrzymywania dobrych relacji ze wszystkimi interesariuszami projektu
Sprawność w podejmowaniu decyzji, rozwiązywania trudności projektowych oraz nastawienie na znajdowanie nowych rozwiązań
Umiejętność analitycznego myślenia oraz wyciągania wniosków
Samodzielność, komunikatywność, inicjatywa oraz orientacja na realizację celów
Dodatkowym atutem będą szkolenia i/lub certyfikaty z metodologii zarządzania projektami np. certyfikat PMP

Budowanie i utrzymywanie trwałych relacji z klientem oraz rozumienie jego potrzeb biznesowych
Zarządzanie projektami wdrożeniowymi systemów informatycznych dla klientów polskich i zagranicznych
Organizacja i koordynacja pracy zespołów projektowych

Tworzenie planu oraz harmonogramu projektu, raportowanie kluczowych parametrów i postępu prac w projekcie
Współpraca z doświadczonymi specjalistami realizującymi projekt
Raportowanie wewnętrzne i do klienta
Tworzenie dokumentacji projektowej

Prywatna opieka medyczna w Allianz - dostęp do specjalistów i badań diagnostycznych dla Ciebie i Twoich najbliższych
System kafeteryjny - możesz wybrać pełne dofinansowanie do karty Multisport czy przeznaczyć środki na kulturę, wypoczynek lub sport i zakupy
Możliwość pracy w modelu hybrydowym po okresie wdrożenia (2 dni pracy zdalnej, 3 dni pracy z biura)
Możliwość korzystania z zaawansowanych narzędzi AI i Google Workspace

new_jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager, Panes Center of Excellence – VELUX - Brædstrup

Step into a role where you will contribute to the development of robust and efficient manufacturing solutions. With your technical insight and hands-on understanding of production environments, you will play a key role in developing and improving production setups that support innovation, cost efficiency, and successful New Product Launches.

Meet your future team

You will join Center of Excellence (CoE) Panes in Brædstrup, where we work at the intersection of operations and development. CoE Panes is a global team located in Brædstrup. We are a team of project managers and technical specialists focusing on the future manufacturing setup in VELUX.

We have a holistic view on the entire supply chain to make sure the manufacturing processes involving Panes are as efficiency as possible, safe for our people and according to our process standard and quality requirement.

In this role, you will primarily collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders based in Denmark, while also supporting selected assembly sites in Europe when relevant.

What We Offer

In this role, you will manage a wide range of technical projects across glass manufacturing. You will transform new product concepts into mature production setups, implement technological upgrades, and help transfer and scale solutions across factories. You will act as the connector between product development, technology, and production, ensuring that new technologies and products are introduced efficiently and with high production robustness.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

Leading projects from concept to implementation, within the field of glass manufacturing.
Defining technical specifications and managing the procurement of manufacturing technologies and production equipment (cutting, tempering, laminating, and production lines).
Participating in process optimization, quality improvement, and product cost reduction initiatives across all glass manufacturing plants of the VELUX Group.
Preparing and maintaining technical requirement specifications in close cooperation with the relevant stakeholders.
Project planning, coordination, and execution, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and within budget – in close collaboration with the glass factories.
Problem-solving and close cooperation with cross-functional teams.
Supporting the standardization of production lines and technical solutions across the various sites

International travel of approximately 40–50 days per year, primarily within Europe, should be expected.

What You Will Bring

You are a structured, proactive, and collaborative Project Manager who takes ownership and delivers consistently. You thrive in a highly technical environment and enjoy working across factory sites, functions, and cultures. Your curious mindset and analytical approach enable you to challenge existing processes and contribute to continuous improvements, always with the goal of creating business value.

Through strong communication and stakeholder management skills, you build trust and ensure alignment across teams. When priorities shift, you remain adaptable, focused, and solution oriented.

Moreover, we expect that you:

A higher education degree in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, mechanical engineering, automation, or a similar field
At least 4-5 years of experience in preparing technical specifications and procuring production equipment.
Experience in technical project management and project planning/execution.
A thorough understanding of manufacturing and assembly processes and their interconnections.
Practical knowledge of manufacturing technologies is an advantage, ideally with experience in glass technology, though not a requirement.
Well-developed problem-solving skills.
Understanding of laser technology, ventilation solutions, and manufacturing processes in clean room environments is highly desirable.
Bring several years of practical project management experience in a technical environment with multiple workstreams
Have strong planning and coordination skills and are comfortable delegating and following up
Communicate effortlessly in English, verbally and in writing. Danish is an advantage but not required

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all requirements. We value different career paths, learning ability, and motivation.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at https://www.velux.com, where you can read more about working with us and what to expect from our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work, and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots. Each year, we create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees, and the planet through our foundations. With production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people worldwide, and our headquarters are in Denmark.

Our values of courage and mutual respect guide how we act and collaborate every day.

At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive, develop, and perform at their best. new_jobs.description:
Join us in driving the energy transition forward. As Project Delivery Manager, you'll coordinate the delivery of our biomethane projects in Poland, connecting development and construction to keep projects moving with clarity and purpose.

What you will do:

Coordinate and deliver assigned biomethane projects from development through Ready-to-Build and construction support until Commercial Operation Date
Lead the structured handover from Development to Construction, ensuring technical, commercial, permitting and contractual information is fully transferred
Act as primary point of contact after handover, supporting the Construction team and ensuring continuity of decisions and information
Maintain project documentation, trackers and transparent reporting on progress, risks, budget and schedule
Coordinate activities required to reach Ready-to-Build, including permitting, land and grid-related workstreams
Monitor schedule and budget against the approved business case, flagging deviations early and escalating when needed

What you bring & who you are:

Degree in Engineering, Business, Environmental Sciences, or a related field.
4+ years of experience in project management, project coordination, project development, or construction delivery, preferably within renewable energy, biogas/biomethane, or other capital-intensive infrastructure sectors.

The impact you’ll make

As a Program/Project Manager, you will serve as a crucial link between the manufacturing and supply chain departments. Your role involves consistent interaction with both sectors to minimize shipment risks. This is achieved by ensuring the accuracy of components, their location, quantity, and quality. The person will act as an interface to cross-functional teams consisting of manufacturing, order fulfillment, logistics, and engineering to ensure the manufacturing production and customer delivery are met.

Develop and deliver clear and concise communications for leadership teams and stakeholders.
Scenario Planning: Be capable of scenario planning based on provided forecasted plan to share supplier healthiness and drive root cause action plan for improving internal process to prevent shipment delay.
Project Management: Manage non-technical, supply chain projects using an internal customer perspective, typically from initiation through delivery. Build solutions that will improve Supply Chain business processes and support critical business strategies.

Lead and participate in projects to resolve problems or to support continuous process improvement.
